title: Storage Sacks
body:
Storage Sacks adds a collection of bundle upgrades that can hold more items, but are filtered to a specific resource type.

![A full rock sack from the mod, holding eight stacks of cobblestone and similar junk.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3tkHWu2g/images/d2fb43d58213e830166f6de1ddee96ad52296308.png)

## Getting Started

All sacks require an empty vanilla bundle of any colour to craft. All recipes are available on the [the wiki](https://docs.jackf.red/storage-sacks/types), the recipe book or your favourite recipe viewer.

Currently, there are 7 types of sacks:

- **Large Sack**: can hold up to 2 stacks worth of any item.
- **Builder's Sack**: the same as the **Large Sack**, but additionally can place from it's contents randomly.
- **Rock Sack**: can hold up to 8 stacks worth of cobblestone, dirt, and other mining detritus.
- **Mining Sack**: can hold up to 4 stacks worth of mined resources, gems and dusts.
- **Potion Sack**: can hold up to 4 potions.
- **Lumber Sack**: can hold up to 6 stacks of logs, saplings and sticks.
- **Seed Sack**: can hold up to 4 stacks of crops, seeds and saplings. Can also place from it's contents randomly.

## Dependencies

Storage Sacks requires Fabric Loader and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
